name: apprunner
description: App Runner App Runner is an application service that provides a fast, simple, and cost-effective way to go directly from an existing container image or source code to a running service in the Amazon Web Services Cloud in seconds.

subcommands.name: associate-custom-domain
subcommands.description: Associate your own domain name with the App Runner subdomain URL of your App Runner service.

subcommands.name: create-auto-scaling-configuration
subcommands.description: Create an App Runner automatic scaling configuration resource.

subcommands.name: create-connection
subcommands.description: Create an App Runner connection resource.

subcommands.name: create-observability-configuration
subcommands.description: Create an App Runner observability configuration resource.

subcommands.name: create-service
subcommands.description: Create an App Runner service.

subcommands.name: create-vpc-connector
subcommands.description: Create an App Runner VPC connector resource.

subcommands.name: create-vpc-ingress-connection
subcommands.description: Create an App Runner VPC Ingress Connection resource.

subcommands.name: delete-auto-scaling-configuration
subcommands.description: Delete an App Runner automatic scaling configuration resource.

subcommands.name: delete-connection
subcommands.description: Delete an App Runner connection.

subcommands.name: delete-observability-configuration
subcommands.description: Delete an App Runner observability configuration resource.

subcommands.name: delete-service
subcommands.description: Delete an App Runner service.

subcommands.name: delete-vpc-connector
subcommands.description: Delete an App Runner VPC connector resource.

subcommands.name: delete-vpc-ingress-connection
subcommands.description: Delete an App Runner VPC Ingress Connection resource that's associated with an App Runner service.

subcommands.name: describe-auto-scaling-configuration
subcommands.description: Return a full description of an App Runner automatic scaling configuration resource.

subcommands.name: describe-custom-domains
subcommands.description: Return a description of custom domain names that are associated with an App Runner service.

subcommands.name: describe-observability-configuration
subcommands.description: Return a full description of an App Runner observability configuration resource.

subcommands.name: describe-service
subcommands.description: Return a full description of an App Runner service.

subcommands.name: describe-vpc-connector
subcommands.description: Return a description of an App Runner VPC connector resource.

subcommands.name: describe-vpc-ingress-connection
subcommands.description: Return a full description of an App Runner VPC Ingress Connection resource.

subcommands.name: disassociate-custom-domain
subcommands.description: Disassociate a custom domain name from an App Runner service.

subcommands.name: list-auto-scaling-configurations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of active App Runner automatic scaling configurations in your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-connections
subcommands.description: Returns a list of App Runner connections that are associated with your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-observability-configurations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of active App Runner observability configurations in your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-operations
subcommands.description: Return a list of operations that occurred on an App Runner service.

subcommands.name: list-services
subcommands.description: Returns a list of running App Runner services in your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-services-for-auto-scaling-configuration
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the associated App Runner services using an auto scaling configuration.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: List tags that are associated with for an App Runner resource.

subcommands.name: list-vpc-connectors
subcommands.description: Returns a list of App Runner VPC connectors in your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-vpc-ingress-connections
subcommands.description: Return a list of App Runner VPC Ingress Connections in your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: pause-service
subcommands.description: Pause an active App Runner service.

subcommands.name: resume-service
subcommands.description: Resume an active App Runner service.

subcommands.name: start-deployment
subcommands.description: Initiate a manual deployment of the latest commit in a source code repository or the latest image in a source image repository to an App Runner service.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Add tags to, or update the tag values of, an App Runner resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Remove tags from an App Runner resource.

subcommands.name: update-default-auto-scaling-configuration
subcommands.description: Update an auto scaling configuration to be the default.

subcommands.description: Update an App Runner service.
